scope: Direct visual review of all eight exact v3 contact PNGs, 104 native poses generated from actual Main production MotionController QA-clocked capture. Review of true heading, source-faithful coherent head/core proportions, attached whole-body mechanics, loaded paws and attack/hit/death progression.

observations_by_direction.E: True right profile in all five states; muzzle/ear size remains comparable as attack crouches/reaches and hit arches shoulders. Near/far paws remain attached and loaded support paws stay grounded; final corpse has continuous spine and tucked limbs.
observations_by_direction.SE: Front-right quarter is distinct from full E and S. Gait/reach/hit preserve attached forequarter/hips; yaw stays SE through collapse. Stance changes expose different amount of chest without the prior 1.4-1.5x rear torso jump.
observations_by_direction.S: Front face and chest remain centered, two eyes/ears readable. Alternating stride reaches and forepaw strike are visible; hit is an upright hunched recoil with broader exposed shoulders, while skull and attached core remain coherent. Death curls downward into grounded frontal corpse.
observations_by_direction.SW: Front-left quarter retained through all phases; snout and reach point down-left, far paws remain distinguishable, body has no detached fragments. Low attack and collapse retain own head/core proportions.
observations_by_direction.W: True left profile, independently directed forepaw reach; attack head/core no longer expands from the standing frame. Hip and shoulder mass remain comparable during red recoil; side corpse stays connected to tail and paws.
observations_by_direction.NW: Back-left quarter with away-facing head and visible rear/haunches; new attack and hit keep own idle/walk shoulder/hip mass rather than former oversized rear core. Forelimb strike goes away-left; death presents an attached away-facing curled body.
observations_by_direction.N: Full rear heading keeps ears/head away and tail centered-to-right as it flexes. New raised forepaw attack changes shoulder height rather than inflating torso; red hit remains within own living rear body scale. Final corpse is rear-facing with attached folded haunches.
observations_by_direction.NE: Back-right quarter maintains away-right head, visible rump and long tail. New right-up reach retains head/core mass, recovery and recoil stay connected; collapse lands as a rear-right corpse with no camera-facing replacement.

prior_v2_failure_recheck: W/NW/N/NE living attack/hit poses no longer exhibit the prior 1.4-1.5x rear core growth. Remaining silhouette changes correspond to crouch, back arch, forelimb extension or collapse; no broken frame, detached torso/legs, false mirror heading or empty pose observed.
limits: Contact images support bounded native phase visual review. They are uniformly halved diagnostic views of Main readbacks, not additional animation assets.
QA-clocked sequence is not wall-time performance or independent AI/combat correctness evidence. Root separately owns ordinary Main AI/combat/lifecycle checks.
No Android real-device test performed; no completion count, profile, production PNG or game code edited by this reviewer.
